name: The Devil's Plan
description: It's the ultimate showdown of wits, brains, strategy, and alliances for a chance to win 500 million won.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Twelve contestants begin their 7-day journey. The first match is nothing like what they've expected — it's time to get those brain cells working!

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The results of the first match have everyone shocked. Someone from the losing team must go to jail. When the next match begins, conflict starts brewing.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: It's day 2, and people are eager to form deeper alliances. This time, the match will result in the very first elimination. Who will be sent home?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The group grows emotional over the result of the first elimination. Meanwhile, a contestant happens upon a secret hidden by the Devil.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The ORBIT alliance or a new alliance? While the contestants rethink their loyalties, someone commits an act of betrayal during the main match.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A betrayal leads to an unforeseen elimination. Emotions flare among the remaining players, but in this prize match, they must work as a team.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: It's day 4, and a group commits a fatal mistake. As their allegiances waver, other contestants come closer to unlocking the Devil's secret.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The contestants struggle to solve the Devil's secret. During the fifth main match, Lee See-won attempts to face off against ORBIT.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The competition takes a new turn due to one player's surprising move. Shortly afterward, the truth surrounding the move is revealed.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The secrets of the prison result in a painful night for some. The last main match of the competition commences. Who will move on to the next round?

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Contestants give it their all in the main match, but only three emerge triumphant. The last prize match begins.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: The 7-day journey is nearing the end, and it's time for the final match. Who among the remaining two will be crowned winner?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Fourteen diverse contestants gather as shocking house rules are unveiled, setting the stage for a thrilling first game of alliances and deception.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The first match delivers unexpected twists, sending seven to prison. There, a high-stakes prison match determines who will face the first elimination.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: An elimination warns the inmates of what’s at stake — but can they win the next match? Meanwhile, secrets brew between the prison and living areas.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The arrival of a new inmate sparks talk about forming alliances or marking the inmate as the next target. Elsewhere, someone steps into the Devil's test.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: In a match where alliances and strategy are crucial, a contestant disrupts the existing alliance, shaking the game's foundation and heightening tension.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: New alliances form, yet some conceal their true intentions. As the game shifts, an unexpected elimination occurs, altering the dynamics.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A brutal prison match determines the fifth elimination. Between living areas and prison, no allies remain — only hierarchy persists.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: On day four, a creative player is eliminated in the main match. A prisoner's fate hangs in the balance as the inmate loses mental stamina.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The remaining prisoners galvanize when an inmate is eliminated. One player's efforts are focused on taking down Jeong Hyun-gyu in the main match.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Amidst ongoing betrayals, emotions explode. But eliminations continue, and complex feelings begin to overwhelm the remaining players.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: With one main match remaining before the finale, alliances face a true test; twists unfold, ultimately deciding the final two contestants.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: As all the players gather to watch, the fate-deciding final battle begins; who will emerge as the ultimate brain and champion?
